critical_code_review_comments: CartProvider.addItem now correctly calls `await load()` after POST /carts/me/items — fixes the SHOP-line wipe. clear() also went through load(). Both were the exact root-cause fixes required by Fixing_Prompt v3 §4. Verified end-to-end.
ShopHome.jsx `abs()` helper correctly prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only for relative `/api/homepage/uploads/…` paths, leaving absolute URLs untouched — safe for both seed data and admin uploads.

TopNav.jsx + AddressPill.jsx moduleAccent = MODULES.find(activeModule).color, memoised on activeModule — flips instantly on route change because ModuleTabs syncs activeModule from useLocation() in a mount effect. No FOUC observed on hard-refresh /shop.
Homepage banner_trio renders exactly 3 tiles from config.banners[]; renderer safely returns null when banners array is empty, so unknown/empty configs never crash /shop.

Minor cosmetic: lucide-react's ShoppingCart/Sparkles SVGs inherit the `color: <accent>` from parent style prop rather than setting it on the svg element itself, so getComputedStyle(svg).color returns '' in JS. The visible pixel is correct (verified in screenshots). Not a bug — just note that any future colour-assertion tests should read the inline style on the parent button/wrapper, not on the SVG.

The `flex-shrink min-w-0` around AddressPill (TopNav.jsx L68) is only shown lg+; on mobile the pill is rendered by the mobile shell, so on 390px viewport the top-nav-delivery-address testid is intentionally absent from the sticky header — this is by design, not a regression.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the global-cart bug was CartProvider.addItem() calling `setCart(data)` with the MART-only /carts/me/items response, replacing the merged (MART+SHOP) local state and silently dropping SHOP lines from the UI (server data was intact). Fix: `await load()` after the POST, which re-fetches BOTH /carts/me + /shop/cart/me and rebuilds the merged shape. Verified: SHOP→MART sequence retains both lines on /cart AND after hard refresh; backend independence tests confirm both endpoints stay consistent.
